releases.notes:
This is the first release of the difficult edition of the ThridLife mod. This contains all features from the "difficult" branch.

In this release /deaths was replaced with /lives and it no longer takes arguments.

## The following difficulty changes are applied to the difficult version:
- Bookshelves do not buff enchant tables
- Zombie villagers cannot be cured
- Bastions cannot contain netherite upgrade templates
- Blazes do not drop blaze rods
- Ancient debris is 20x more common bc funny
### The following recipes are disabled:
- anvil
- end crystal
- mace
- respawn anchor
### The following recipes have been modified to be possible to craft:
- ender chest (eye of ender is replaced with ender pearl)
- shulker box (8 pearls around a chest)
- tnt (recipe is changed to 5 sand 4 paper and 1 gunpowder to be easier to craft)

releases.notes:
Does not contain any difficulty changes, and only has a basic ThirdLife implementation with a few commands

This will most likely be the last version (excluding the more difficult version) unless bugs are found or mojang releases 1.21.9 because it has pretty much everything needed and as far as I am aware does not contain bugs or issues. If any are found updates will be released.

The difficult version is made for a specific server and will keep being updated as more changes are made as unlike this, that mod actually has more besides just ThirdLife.

Sorry if my writing is bad; I do not feel like putting time into writing as I have spent most of my time today writing java.

Please note that this mod is intended for servers and cannot ban players after they have lost all of their lives in singleplayer. Client-sided functionality is not planned.
